context: The screenshot a reviewer sent from ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium) rendered in a web browser at night. The reviewer overlay captured the browser tab and drew the reviewer's pin on top of the frame. Depending on which layers are built, the scene shows a ground grid with a red ring marking the Belfry, and possibly also buildings, water, lights and other city data.
